title: Havok reflection tables for the own-skeleton actor conversions, rebuilt from the decrypted PS3 1.19 and PS4 executables (u3fix.exe actors-hk, actor33/actors_hk.cpp)
notes: Exit 3 is no longer recorded as applied (recipe 1.10.3): before, an import without the EBOOT.elf never ran this step again once the file was added. Writes toolsets/*/data/hk2010_ps3.json + hk2011_ps4.json in the rendered actor33 job (never shipped: derived from the executables). Inputs: RECIPE_PS3_ELF (decrypted 1.19 EBOOT.elf; the 1.10 disc EBOOT gives different tables) and RECIPE_PS4_ELF (decrypted PS4 eboot), objdump (GNU binutils) for the PS4 constructor scan. Exit 3 = inputs missing: the actor paks with their own Havok collision (Lab boxes, breakable props) then fail in convert-actors. Verified 2026-11-05: both tables sha256-identical to the 11-01 ones (359/306 PS3, 490/341 PS4 classes). Since 2026-11-13 C++ (u3fix.exe actors-hk = actors_hk.py + mkhk.py + mkhk_write.py, GNU objdump still used for the PS4 disassembly): both tables sha256-identical, 25 s, no Python; they stay in TMP/hk, where convert-actors reads them.
